# Editor font attribution

These notices cover the exact 23 font files listed below.
Their original embedded copyright and license metadata remain intact.

Roboto and Droid Sans: Apache-2.0.txt. Cousine and Karla: respective OFL texts.
ProggyClean and ProggyTiny, by Tristan Grimmer: Proggy-MIT.txt.

Five fonts match pinned ImGui archive 1780579403f07158adef7ac2f1e15d7990e732df.
All 18 Roboto font files match the pinned upstream Git sources listed below.
The existing files are unchanged; the two families come from different versions.

Sources: https://github.com/bluescan/proggyfonts and https://github.com/google/fonts
